case.title: Why this needs you
case.displayCollision: Another catalog asset uses the same name or symbol as {symbol}, but the mint is different. A matching label is not proof of identity. Keep it separate if it is real, or exclude it if the evidence shows spam. Only link it to the existing asset when a trusted source proves a migration or equivalent representation.
case.ownershipConflict: Two authorities claim different owners for this identity. Review the evidence and pick which identity is correct.
case.conflictingEvidence: The authorities disagree about basic facts for {symbol}. Review the claims and decide which one to trust.
case.nonExactPlatformMatch: A registry entry matches this token only loosely, such as a different address casing or a wrapped variant. Confirm whether it really is the registry asset before attaching.
case.spamEvidence: Jupiter marked {symbol} as suspicious, but did not ban it. Review the concrete risk signals below. Exclude it if they confirm spam; otherwise keep the mint as a separate real asset.
case.incompatibleDecimals: The observed decimals do not match the asset this would attach to. Attaching with wrong decimals corrupts amounts, so the policy stopped.
case.incompatibleType: The observed asset type does not match the asset this would attach to.
case.unsupportedRepresentation: TaxMaxi does not support this kind of on-chain representation yet, so it cannot create the asset automatically.
case.malformedPayload: The provider sent incomplete or invalid data that TaxMaxi could not read. Exclude the record if the source response is clearly broken; otherwise keep it for another review.
case.upstreamFailure: An upstream data source failed while resolving this observation. The evidence may be incomplete.
case.default: The automatic policy could not resolve this observation and needs a human decision.
case.recommendSpamDescription: Confirm that the risk signals refer to this exact mint, then record the exclusion.
case.recommendCollision: Do not merge on name alone
case.recommendCollisionDescription: Choose a separate asset if it is real, or exclude it if the evidence shows impersonation or wallet spam.
case.recommendUnsupportedDescription: TaxMaxi cannot calculate this representation yet. The decision can be reversed when support lands.
case.recommendDefault: Review the evidence and record one outcome
case.recommendDefaultDescription: The automatic policy stopped because it could not make a safe identity decision.
